reason: Adds capacity_reached (wait for running work, then retry; retry_safe true) and budget_exhausted (do not retry) to the nebula.tool-failure/v1 contract, with Core's limit numbers in a new limit field, and makes every subagent, agent-messaging and catalog-limit refusal raise a typed exception that tool_failure classifies the same way on the provider-chat path (chat.py tool loop via SubagentBroker/AgentMessageBroker) and the harness gateway (_gateway_subagent / _gateway_agent_message now raise to _gateway_call instead of returning a denial). Selected: test_tool_failures.py (envelope unit tests for the new categories and the limit field), the new test_subagent_refusal_categories.py (both paths: provider wait-then-retry at the running limit, goal budget, invalid input, rules; harness wait-then-retry, invalid input, rules, agent messaging), test_chat_subagents.py and test_harness_provider_subagents.py (the operator-limit tests now pin category and limit; start failure is execution_failed), test_chat_agent_messages.py (ToolNotPermitted), test_tool_catalog.py (catalog limit is budget_exhausted), test_chat_subagent_lifecycle.py and test_subagent_delivery.py (subagent start/round/message paths whose refusal types changed), and the one test_turn_write_amplification.py node that expected the start failure type.
exclusions: Full suites are not approved and are excluded. No UI, native Rust/Tauri or Playwright code changed and the UI does not read failure categories, so frontend, native and playwright are empty. tests/v3/test_harnesses.py is not selected: _gateway_call and every other gateway tool are unchanged; only the subagent and agent-message handlers now raise their refusals to it, covered by test_harness_provider_subagents.py, test_chat_agent_messages.py and test_subagent_refusal_categories.py. Mission tooling (agent_tooling.py), test_turn_prompt_cache.py and the browser/process envelope tests are unaffected: tool_failure output for errors other than the new limit types is byte-identical. tests/v3/test_chat_api.py is not selected: the subagent routes are unchanged.
